readiness_notes: Production release authorized on 2026-09-13; final source and Android API 35 lifecycle evidence pass.

Production D1 migration and billing catalog are complete. App Store submission remains blocked by the Account Holder legal-entity update and Paid Apps Agreement; paid lifecycle evidence is still incomplete.

p0_blockers.title: Accept the updated Apple Developer Program Agreement
p0_blockers.why_blocking: The updated Apple Developer Program agreement was accepted by the Account Holder on 2026-08-29.
current_evidence: The Apple Developer account no longer shows the agreement prompt, and App Store Connect no longer shows the agreement warning.
exit_criteria: The Account Holder accepts the current agreement and App Store Connect no longer shows the agreement blocker.

p0_blockers.title: Complete Apple legal entity and Paid Apps Agreement
p0_blockers.why_blocking: Apple will not permit paid apps or in-app purchases until the Account Holder updates the legal entity and signs the Paid Apps Agreement.
current_evidence: App Store Connect Business shows Paid Apps Agreement status New on 2026-09-13.
Apple displays: update legal entity information prior to signing the Paid Apps Agreement.
exit_criteria: The Account Holder supplies and attests the required legal-entity information.
The Account Holder signs the Paid Apps Agreement and App Store Connect reports it Active.

p0_blockers.title: Create and install production billing credentials
p0_blockers.why_blocking: The Worker and RevenueCat cannot verify Apple or Google purchases or deliver account recovery email without production credentials and webhook secrets.
current_evidence: Apple IAP key A7RP99HN55 and the App Store Connect API credential are valid in RevenueCat; the IAP key is backed up in 1Password.
Google Play service-account purchase verification and RTDN delivery to RevenueCat are configured and verified.
Production RevenueCat webhook HMAC is enabled; its rotated secret is installed in the production Worker and backed up in 1Password.
Resend, OpenAI, PostHog, Sentry, auth, and reconciliation secrets are present in the production Worker.
exit_criteria: Manually download Apple In-App Purchase key A7RP99HN55 once and install it in RevenueCat without exposing the private key.
Store the Apple key in 1Password and confirm Apple server-side customer verification in sandbox.
Retain the authenticated RevenueCat-to-Worker webhook and verified Google server-side purchase configuration.

p0_blockers.title: Configure the Apple, Google, and RevenueCat product catalog
p0_blockers.why_blocking: Customers cannot buy Murmur Pro or credit packs until the exact products, prices, entitlement, offering, and packages exist and are linked across both stores and RevenueCat.
current_evidence: Apple monthly/annual subscriptions and all three consumable packs are READY_TO_SUBMIT at the approved prices.

Google monthly/annual base plans are active in 173 regions; murmur_credits_60, murmur_credits_180, and murmur_credits_540 now have ACTIVE purchase options at USD 3.99, USD 10.99, and USD 31.99 with converted regional prices.
Play accepted and activated the billing-capable code 8 internal prerequisite under the replacement upload certificate.
RevenueCat default offering has five packages, each attached to the matching active Apple and Google product; the Pro entitlement contains only subscription products.
exit_criteria: After 2026-09-01 07:32:56 UTC, upload code 7 to internal testing and confirm Google Play accepts the replacement upload certificate and BILLING permission.
Create Google Pro monthly at USD 12.99, Pro annual at USD 124.99, and credit packs at USD 3.99, USD 10.99, and USD 31.99.
Verify the Google products remain linked to RevenueCat entitlement pro and offering default with the documented package identifiers.
Release the verified Android build only to internal, closed Alpha, and open testing tracks.

p0_blockers.title: Complete Apple and Google billing sandbox tests
p0_blockers.why_blocking: The code is locally verified, but production release needs real store evidence for purchase, restore, renewal, expiry, refund, and metered balance behavior.
current_evidence: Local tests cover ledger idempotency, grants, reversals, reconciliation, account merge, and translation metering.

A real development account flow transferred the August Free claim from a fresh guest to the verified company-email customer, committed the D1 merge and alias, revoked the guest principal, and preserved the 30-minute balance.

The development Worker is billing-active and ready. A real one-second PCM attempt reached the Worker, but OpenAI rejected it before acknowledgement because the organization balance is -$0.25; D1 recorded the failed usage session with no settled usage.

iOS 1.2.2 build 13 is in internal TestFlight and awaits external Beta App Review. All Apple products are READY_TO_SUBMIT, but StoreKit product propagation has not completed and the RevenueCat simulator paywall still reports an empty offering.
No completed App Store sandbox or Google Play licensed-tester purchase, renewal, expiry, or refund lifecycle run is recorded for the new catalog.
exit_criteria: Fund the OpenAI organization and record successful acknowledged translation metering against the D1 ledger.
Record successful purchase and restore tests for each platform and product class.
Record renewal, cancellation, expiry, refund, refund reversal, duplicate webhook, reinstall, cross-device sign-in, and negative-balance behavior.
Prove billing enforcement can stay enabled while the purchase kill switch disables new checkout.

p0_blockers.title: Deploy and verify the staged production billing release
p0_blockers.why_blocking: The live Worker and mobile builds must use the verified production configuration before the paid offer can be released safely.
current_evidence: Production D1 migration 0006 is applied after a Time Travel bookmark; pre/post aggregate counts and foreign-key verification match.
Production billing flags are enabled in the release source and the HMAC webhook secret is installed.
Production Worker deployment and the final Android/iOS uploads are in progress.
exit_criteria: Verify readiness, account recovery, entitlement reconciliation, metering, observability, and rollback controls live.
Release approved store builds in stages, enable purchases only after live proof, and verify the deployed revision.
